abstract: Maintains structural deck strength evaluations and technical transit mobilization duration schedules
system_message:
You are the Vessel engineering director (ENG). You maintain structural deck strength evaluations and technical transit mobilization duration schedules for offshore marine contractors evaluated for the North Sea turbine installation vessel charter.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary thruster maintenance（PROP）
information_points.content:
ENG-PROP-K4U：Boreas Heavy Marine has an auxiliary thruster service interval of 4,500 h between scheduled overhauls across its bow tunnel and stern azimuth thruster units according to its planned maintenance schedule.
ENG-PROP-ZA7：Zephyr Offshore Transport registers an auxiliary thruster service interval of 3,000 h between scheduled overhaul cycles for its bow tunnel and stern azimuth thrusters.
ENG-PROP-CQ1：Caledonia Marine Lifting maintains an auxiliary thruster service interval of 6,000 h of operating running time between planned maintenance overhauls for its bow tunnel and stern azimuth thruster units.

information_points.title: Maintains structural deck strength evaluations and technical transit mobilization duration schedules（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
ENG-STRUCT-DDP：For the June 2026 installation campaign window, Boreas Heavy Marine has a certified deck load bearing capacity of 20 t/m2 on the main cargo working deck forward of the crane pedestal without supplemental shoring, and its charter transit voyage plan establishes a contracted mobilization duration of 18 days covering home port sail-out, sea trials, and arrival at the Danish staging base.
ENG-STRUCT-MIJ：For the June 2026 installation campaign window, Caledonia Marine Lifting provides a certified deck load bearing capacity of 15 t/m2 forward of the crane pedestal without supplemental shoring, and its transit voyage plan specifies a contracted mobilization duration of 14 days to complete home port sail-out, sea trials, and Danish staging base delivery.
ENG-STRUCT-HDT：For the June 2026 installation campaign window, Zephyr Offshore Transport exhibits a certified deck load bearing capacity of 10 t/m2 on the main cargo working deck forward of the crane pedestal without supplemental shoring, alongside a contracted mobilization duration of 10 days for transit from its home port through sea trials to the Danish staging base.
ENG-STRUCT-C72：For the July 2026 installation campaign window, Boreas Heavy Marine's evaluation records a deck load bearing capacity of 15 t/m2 forward of the crane pedestal without supplemental shoring, accompanied by a contracted mobilization duration of 10 days from home port through sea trials to the Danish staging base.
